mapper.insert: INSERT INTO weekly_reports( user_id, week_start, week_end, metrics_json, narrative_json, narrative_source, agent_model, recommendation_json, generated_at, read_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{weekStart}, #{weekEnd}, #{metricsJson}, #{narrativeJson}, #{narrativeSource}, #{agentModel}, #{recommendationJson}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NULL ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id), week_end = VALUES(week_end), metrics_json = VALUES(metrics_json), narrative_json = VALUES(narrative_json), narrative_source = VALUES(narrative_source), agent_model = VALUES(agent_model), recommendation_json = VALUES(recommendation_json), generated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, read_at = NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, week_start, week_end, metrics_json, narrative_json, narrative_source, agent_model, recommendation_json, generated_at, read_at FROM weekly_reports WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND week_start = #{weekStart}

SELECT id, user_id, week_start, week_end, metrics_json, narrative_json, narrative_source, agent_model, recommendation_json, generated_at, read_at FROM weekly_reports WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY week_start DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id, week_start, week_end, metrics_json, narrative_json, narrative_source, agent_model, recommendation_json, generated_at, read_at FROM weekly_reports WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS sessionCount, COALESCE(SUM(total_count), 0) AS questionCount, COALESCE(SUM(correct_count), 0) AS correctCount, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(correct_count) / NULLIF(SUM(total_count), 0) * 100, 2), 0) AS accuracy, COALESCE(SUM(duration_seconds), 0) AS studySeconds FROM practice_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'SUBMITTED' AND submitted_at >= #{start} AND submitted_at < #{end}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE(submitted_at), '%Y-%m-%d') AS practiceDate, COALESCE(SUM(total_count), 0) AS questionCount, COALESCE(SUM(correct_count), 0) AS correctCount, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(correct_count) / NULLIF(SUM(total_count), 0) * 100, 2), 0) AS accuracy FROM practice_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'SUBMITTED' AND submitted_at >= #{start} AND submitted_at < #{end} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(DATE(submitted_at), '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY MIN(submitted_at)

SELECT q.question_type AS type, COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN q.is_correct = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS correct, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN q.is_correct = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2), 0) AS accuracy FROM practice_questions q JOIN practice_sessions s ON s.id = q.session_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.status = 'SUBMITTED' AND s.submitted_at >= #{start} AND s.submitted_at < #{end} GROUP BY q.question_type ORDER BY accuracy ASC, total DESC

SELECT q.canonical_key AS canonicalKey, MAX(q.expression) AS expression, q.question_type AS type, COUNT(*) AS errorCount, MAX(q.correct_answer) AS correctAnswer FROM practice_questions q JOIN practice_sessions s ON s.id = q.session_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.status = 'SUBMITTED' AND s.submitted_at >= #{start} AND s.submitted_at < #{end} AND q.is_correct = FALSE GROUP BY q.canonical_key, q.question_type ORDER BY errorCount DESC, MAX(s.submitted_at) DESC LIMIT 5
